name: Creature Immunities
description: Defines named sets of damage/effect/mechanic immunities that can be applied to (and removed from) a creature entry, e.g. via EventAI ACTION_T_SET_IMMUNITY_SET.

fields.name: Set Id
fields.help: Arbitrary id grouping several (Type, Value) immunity rows into one named set for this creature entry. Referenced by EventAI action ACTION_T_SET_IMMUNITY_SET to toggle the whole set on/off at runtime.

fields.name: Value
fields.help: Meaning depends on Type: a SpellEffects value, AuraType value, SpellSchoolMask bitmask, DispelType value, or Mechanics value respectively.
